comments.quote: 這家酒店應該是騙子酒店，我們是2025年11月22日晚定的房，開車去了，沒有燈牌，酒店電話也不接，到了第二天，多次打電話也未接通，壞境差，晚上外面又沒有燈，感覺很怕，很害怕。
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: This place looks to me like a scam. We booked on the evening of 22 November 2025 and drove there. There was no sign lit, and nobody answered the phone. The next day I rang repeatedly and still got nothing. The setting is poor and with no lights outside at night it was frightening.
